responsibility: Provides the detailed NEON/VFP scheduling model component for Cortex-A8. It classifies SIMD and floating-point instructions into many Cortex-A8-specific NEON categories and assigns reservations and bypasses for integer-vector, multiply, shift, permute, load/store, VFP, and transfer operations, supplying the SIMD/FPU half of the Cortex-A8 tuning model used by the main cortex-a8 scheduler.
